about_the_game:
As the heir of a mineral extraction company, you'll have to make your business as successful as possible. Upgrade that Mega Drill of yours, buy new lands to exploit and crush all and every public unrest that gets in your way.

Features:

  • Action / Management hybrid game: Drill the land to extract precious minerals and sell them to upgrade your drill or buy more land lots.

  • Procedurally generated worlds: Every game is different thanks to procedurally generated islands where rivers, mountains and population are distributed in new ways every time.

  • Configure your Drill: Several different drill parts allow you to adjust your strategy to your needs. Gathering as much minerals as possible or going after only the most precious ones, there are tools for everything!

  • Control the economy: Sell now or store your minerals to wait for better prices. Influence the economy by bribing the government or simply by withholding those precious minerals.

  • Manage your public image: Some of the things you'll do won't be popular. Control your image with promotional campaigns and keeping public attention away.

short_description: Run your mining empire to success and become the richest person in the world! Mega Drill is an action, management, upgrade game with a digging theme. Procedurally generated islands make every run different!
